description:
Hello! 
I’m Victoria, a teenager who likes to inspire young audiences, by teaching them about space.
summary: Project Mars is an educational 2D game about surviving a one-day emergency alone on Mars. Instead of controlling a character, you play through menus and hand drawn screens, making key choices to keep your vital stats up and send data back to Earth. Your decisions decide if the mission succeeds or fails, showing what it really takes to be an astronaut on planetary missions. All of this, while learning interesting facts about Mars.
details:
Project Mars was built in GDevelop as a short mission trainer designed to teach kids and teens real, simplified NASA science about Mars. Instead of controlling a walking character, players learn directly by navigating through custom hand drawn screens, computer interfaces, and quick decision menus.

Because it is brief and straight to the point, the game keeps young audiences entertained while covering essential space survival topics like, hunger, sleep, and energy management. Through these mechanics, players experience the harsh reality that food and water do not naturally exist on Mars, meaning every single resource inside the dome has to be carefully managed and maintained.

Ultimately, the goal is to show kids and teens how critical planning and adaptability are on real planetary missions. By putting them in a one-day emergency scenario, the game teaches them that unexpected mistakes can happen at any moment, and that staying calm, thinking fast, and making the right choice can make a difference between mission success and failure. All of this is wrapped in an accessible, videogame-style experience that makes space exploration both fun and easy to understand.
dataRefs: NASA Human Research Program – Exercise Physiology & Countermeasures
